name: virtual-list
title: Virtual list
description: Windowed list that renders only the visible rows. 100,000 items stay smooth.
htmlExample:
<bef-virtual-list id="vl" style="width:320px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px"></bef-virtual-list>
<script>document.getElementById('vl').props = { items: Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => 'Row ' + (i + 1)), rowHeight: 36, height: 280, renderRow: (t) => t };</script>
